title: Lithic theme
description: A calm card-issuing fintech theme: white page, black ink, one hot orange for actions, and pale washes for each band (faint bronze, mint, lavender with deep amethyst ink, peach). Big 24px-rounded panels, pill buttons, one neo-grotesk in two weights. The dark sibling is the original's black panels: white ink, glassy white/10 cards and a light-bronze accent.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the original's black hero and services panels read the .dark colours by putting `dark` on the panel
surfaces: muted = faint bronze, secondary = mint, accent = lavender (accent-foreground = amethyst ink), highlight = dark bronze (light-bronze gold in .dark), chart-2 = emerald for mint contour lines
